in_marathi.name: Vilas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे mansion, abode of beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vilas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A beautiful mansion, an abode of beauty and prosperity. The name Vilas evokes a sense of happiness and prosperity, and is often given to a child as a wish for a life filled with joy and beauty. In Hindu mythology, the god Vishnu is known as Vilas, the patron of beauty and art.
